DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma.

The findings of an erythematous plaque with crusting, irregular borders on the penile shaft and finger, combined with biopsy results showing nuclear hyperchromasia and increased mitotic figures, are highly characteristic of Squamous Cell Carcinoma. The negative STD panel rules out infectious etiologies like Syphilis.
